results.title: Economics (ECO) < DePaul University
results.content: # Economics (ECO). **ECO 101 | INTRODUCTION TO ECONOMIC ISSUES | 4 quarter hours**. This course will introduce students to basic concepts from both micro- and macroeconomics. The goal is for students to gain an appreciation of how economics can be used to understand the world. Students will enhance their analytical skills by using basic economic concepts to examine current domestic and international issues. This course is intended for non-Commerce students and cannot be counted toward a major or minor in economics. **ECO 105 | PRINCIPLES OF MICROECONOMICS | 4 quarter hours**. **MAT 101 (or equivalent) is a prerequisite for this class.**. The goal of the topics course is to introduce students to the discipline of economics through the study of a specific issue at the introductory level. **ECO 105, ECO 106 and status as an ECO major in either the College of Business or the College of Liberals Arts & Social Sciences is a prerequisite of this class.**. **ECO 304 | ANALYTICS FOR ECONOMICS | 4 quarter hours**.
